result.summary: The page renders cleanly overall: the layout is aligned, images load, and the typography and spacing are consistent. The only findings are minor low-contrast gray text. Intentionally clipped carousel items and the cut-off card at the bottom were excluded per the instructions.

issues.description: Light gray secondary text, such as the search placeholder, delivery fees, and the '(500+)' rating count, appears to have low contrast against the white or light gray backgrounds, which may be hard to read.
issues.suggestion: Darken the secondary text color to meet WCAG AA contrast of at least 4.5:1 for small text and 3:1 for placeholder text.
